steps.name: h3-hub-1-editor-commit-scope
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'TestEditorCommit|TestEditorSendStatus|TestEditorAPI' -count=1 -v . 2>&1 | tee /tmp/h3-hub-1.log && grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestEditorCommitScopedToItsApp' /tmp/h3-hub-1.log && grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestEditorSendStatusScopedToItsApp' /tmp/h3-hub-1.log && ! grep -q -- '--- FAIL' /tmp/h3-hub-1.log && go test ./... -count=1 && cd ../.. && test -z "$(git diff --name-only h3 | grep -v -E '^(tools/orb-manager/|docs/)')"
